attributes.board_name: Delaware Board of Pharmacy (Division of Professional Regulation)

rules.alternatives: Certified pharmacy technicians must pass the PTCB exam or another Board-approved national exam; keeping that national certification follows the certifier's own CE rules.
rules.notes: Delaware does not license or register pharmacy technicians, so no state CE applies. The Pharmacy Practice Act (24 Del. C. ch. 25) licenses pharmacists and interns only; technicians and certified technicians work under a pharmacist's supervision after training arranged by the pharmacy permit holder.
rules.rule_quote: Other responsibilities may be delegated to a certified pharmacy technician or pharmacy technicians who are under the direct supervision of a pharmacist.
